# Mukul — Frontend Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio of Mukul Bushi Reddy M (Mukul), a Frontend Developer specializing in Angular, TypeScript, React, Flutter, and AI-integrated web products.

Mukul builds responsive, user-centric digital products end-to-end — from concept to production. Focus areas: Angular, TypeScript, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, Firebase, Node.js, and AI integration (Gemini API).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero, work, skills, evolution timeline, and contact for Mukul.
- [Engineering Case Studies](/work): Technical case studies — architecture, performance, and AI integration behind featured products.

## Case Studies

- [Emergent](/work/emergent): AI planning engine with typed Gemini output, streaming UI, and Firebase persistence.
- [Smart Posture](/work/smart-posture): Flutter app with on-device sensor pipeline, Firebase Realtime DB sync, and animated feedback.
- [Telegram Gemini Bot](/work/telegram-gemini-bot): Webhook-driven Node service with rolling-summary session memory and Gemini intent routing.
